propositions: Current CLI implementation has fragmented parsers split across reusable argparse objects, imperative argv loops, 54 hand-maintained help files, and 22 intercept descriptions causing command-census drift and disagreement between parser, runtime help, and documentation

Runtime command handlers and their corresponding documentation must derive from a single side-effect-free argparse factory per grammar family to establish canonical help and prevent duplication or regex-based command reconstruction
Parser migrations must maintain byte-for-byte parity in accepted/rejected argv, diagnostics, streams, and exit codes while atomically switching runtime handlers to use shared factories

Generated help artifacts and grouped overview must be byte-deterministic and served before operation/config/store/handler/optional-import boundaries, with aliases reusing canonical definitions and retired commands remaining undiscoverable
